records.subject: spec-guard-claude-code-cli
evidence: result:user-scope plugin updated from 0.38.2 to 0.38.3 and is enabled; a new session is required to apply it
result:all 144 distributed files in the installed cache are byte-for-byte identical to git archive v0.38.3

records.subject: spec-guard-claude-code-cli-hook
evidence: host:a new Claude Code CLI session loaded the installed v0.38.3 plugin from its cache and ran in an isolated synthetic Git project
result:one UserPromptSubmit hook response machine event carried the valid MAP_ONLY stage and Claude exited 0
limit:the synthetic project contained no real repository content; this proves installed Claude Code hook injection, not Claude Desktop behavior

records.subject: spec-guard-local-ticket-reply
evidence: host:a fresh Claude Code CLI session used the installed v0.38.3 ticket command and skill against one synthetic Epiq issue in an isolated repository and isolated EPIQ_GLOBAL_DIR
result:epiq_issue_list actually ran; the user reply contained the read title and short reference, omitted the full internal ID, and no ticket write tool was called
limit:this proves the installed-version synthetic reply path, not a response over the user's real Local ledger

records.subject: spec-guard-real-local-ticket-reply
evidence: host:a fresh Claude Code CLI session used installed v0.38.3 in the user's real Local ledger, querying only one newly created synthetic acceptance issue by short reference
result:epiq_issue_get actually ran and returned the synthetic issue; the final reply included its read title and short reference and omitted the full internal ID
boundary:no existing private issue was listed or read, and the host invoked no ticket write or sync tool; the synthetic issue remains open
limit:this proves the targeted real-ledger reply path, not a broad listing of existing tickets or a remote sync

records.subject: spec-guard-claude-code-desktop-hook
evidence: host:a new Claude desktop Code-mode session used an isolated synthetic Git project with a capability map and no module specs
result:the session transcript contains a UserPromptSubmit hook_additional_context attachment with the valid MAP_ONLY stage; the app reply reported the same stage
limit:this verifies Claude Code in the desktop app, not the retired Claude Desktop MCPB or the user's real Local ticket ledger

records.subject: spec-guard-claude-desktop-mcpb
records.reason: The ordinary Claude Desktop MCPB surface was retired on 2026-09-28; its manifest, server, and package path are absent from v0.38.3. See docs/retirements/claude-desktop-mcpb.md.
